reserveReview.rationale: The 100% share-and-cash envelope mirrors IAUon and SLVon; issuer API Physical Gold weight describes the underlying ETF, not a measured GLDon reserve mix. Final Terms permit Other Collateral and Additional Collateral, whose current usage is not established. Program trust disclosures require additional collateral beyond full backing at all times and describe a contractually obligated Ondo Foundation guarantee through Flux Finance, Inc. These are documented program commitments, not a measured GLDon overcollateralization ratio or a token-specific independent reconciliation.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Final Terms name Alpaca and BitGo as custodians and fiat-account providers and Ankura as verification/security agent, but disclose no current GLDon-specific provider shares or GLD/cash/Other Collateral allocation. Collateral lending requires prior issuer-investor agreement; this is not an unconditional prohibition of reuse. The underlying ETF adds another custody layer. These named roles and program segregation establish partial safeguards, not whole-book institutional-regulated custody. Current aggregate attestation account categories cannot be attributed to GLDon.
